verdict.rationale: First-party docs say designers can turn static mockups into shareable interactive prototypes without code, PRs, or code review, and can sketch feature flows. Refinement happens through conversation, inline comments, direct edits, and sliders rather than a dedicated interaction-wiring editor. Nothing in the pack documents explicit triggers, transitions, or overlays, so only the core 'interactive prototype, no code' claim is supported. Missing for 10: documented trigger/transition/overlay controls, a visual screen-linking workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of clickable prototype interactions.
